HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about External Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing External Security.
   B. Explain External Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat External Security as rumours only.
   D. Say External Security never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya.
   B. Say Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   A. Explain Human developmen ts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human developmen ts in Africa.

   A. Plan income and spending wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain African Diaspora and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. B — Explain External Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. B — Explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A — Explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. C — Explain Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A — Explain Human developmen ts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A — Plan income and spending wisely

10. A — Explain symbols used on a map

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Peace and conflict transformatio n at the global level.; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
